title: ALL ( column ) as a table expression returns every value of the column, ignoring the filter on it

source.quote: ignoring the filter on product color
source.supports: the page's example runs the same query on its model and lists every color despite the filter on Red

source.quote: Using a single column argument, ALL returns all the unique values of the column.
source.supports: with one column ALL returns all its unique values

derivation: Product[Color] holds Red, Red, Blue, Green: the unique values are Red, Blue, Green. The filter Color = Red is ignored. The sales model has no orphans, so there is no blank row.
